titles: 원유 1위 미국이 한국 기름을 사 간다… 원유 한 방울 안 나는 한국이 '기름 파는 나라'가 된 이유
원유 1위 미국이 한국 기름을 사 간다… 원유 0인 한국이 '기름 파는 나라'가 된 진짜 이유
"비행기 기름 10통 중 7통이 한국산" 원유 1위 미국이 한국 기름을 사는 진짜 이유
thumbnail_texts: "비행기 기름 10통 중 7통" / 미국이 한국에서 사 간다
"정유소 문 닫는 미국" / 원유 0 한국이 기름을 판다

image_concepts.A: 한국 주인공 대비(사용자 지정) — 오른쪽 2/3 해 질 녘 불 켜진 울산 정유단지 + 부두를 떠나는 대형 유조선, 왼쪽 1/3 쇠사슬·자물쇠로 닫힌 미국 정유소 철문과 꺼진 굴뚝
image_concepts.B: 한 장면 대비 — 미국 서부 공항 활주로 옆 급유 장면과 항구에 닿은 한국발 유조선

meta.note: 사용자 지정 「야경」은 채널 규칙(밤·어두운 장면 회피)과 충돌 → 1번은 「해 질 녘 블루아워 + 밝은 노출 + 단지 불빛」으로 절충. 정유사 로고·실존 인물 얼굴 금지

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한국 주인공 대비(사용자 지정). 오른쪽 3분의 2를 해 질 녘 하늘 아래 수천 개 불빛이 켜진 거대한 한국 해안 정유단지(증류탑·배관·원형 탱크)가 크게 차지하고, 앞 부두에서 대형 유조선이 물살을 가르며 출항한다. 안전모 쓴 한국 작업자 두세 명이 부두에서 출항을 지켜본다. 왼쪽 3분의 1에 녹슨 철문을 굵은 쇠사슬과 자물쇠로 감은 미국 정유소, 뒤로 불 꺼진 굴뚝과 빈 주차장. 가운데 큰 인물 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic Korean-hero contrast composition, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on steel, pipes and water. The right two-thirds of the frame, larger and closer in a slightly heroic low-angle shot: a vast South Korean coastal oil refinery complex at blue hour, towering distillation columns, dense steel pipe racks and white round storage tanks glowing with thousands of warm golden lights, a huge crude and product tanker leaving the pier in the foreground with a white wake, three Korean workers in hard hats and orange safety vests on the pier watching it depart, faces lit and readable. The sky is a bright luminous blue-hour gradient with glowing orange horizon, exposure kept bright with lifted shadows so every structure shows full detail. The left third of the frame, smaller and further back, separated by a sharp diagonal seam: a closed American refinery gate, rusty chain-link fence and steel gate wrapped with a heavy chain and big padlock, dead dark smokestacks and an empty parking lot behind, cold grey-blue desaturated tones but bright daylight exposure. No large central figure. Vivid saturated colors, split color accents of warm golden refinery lights versus cold grey rust, triumphant atmosphere. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no flags with text, no real identifiable people. Avoid: pitch-black night, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 장면 대비 — 미국 서부 항구. 앞쪽에 한국에서 온 대형 유조선이 접안해 굵은 호스를 연결 중이고, 뒤 언덕 너머로 불 꺼진 미국 정유소 굴뚝이 보인다. 부두의 미국 작업자들이 호스를 받는다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic single-scene contrast at a sunny US West Coast port, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain, crisp textures on steel hull, ropes and hoses. In the foreground a massive clean, freshly painted product tanker is berthed, thick black loading hoses being connected to the pier manifold, American dock workers in hard hats guiding the hoses with focused faces. In the background on a hill, an old idle refinery with rusted towers and cold smokestacks, no smoke, a chained gate. Bright high-key late-afternoon light with lifted shadows, vivid saturated colors, warm sunlight on the tanker versus muted grey rust on the idle refinery. Sense of a quiet reversal. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 장면 대비형(인물 없음) — 왼쪽 절반은 쇠사슬이 감긴 미국 정유소 철문과 잡초 난 진입로, 오른쪽 절반은 불빛이 가득한 한국 정유단지와 부두의 유조선. 대각선 경계.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic split-world single frame, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast and visible film grain. The left half shows the entrance of a closed American oil refinery, a tall steel gate wrapped with a heavy rusty chain and padlock, weeds growing through cracked asphalt, idle towers behind, cool desaturated grey-blue tones but bright daylight exposure. The right half shows a huge South Korean seaside refinery complex at golden dusk, distillation towers and pipe racks glowing with warm lights, a large tanker at the pier being loaded, bright luminous sky. The two halves meet at a sharp diagonal seam. Bright high-key exposure, vivid saturated colors, split color accents of warm gold versus cold grey, scratched and weathered textures on the chain and gate. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: pitch-black night, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업 — 쇠사슬과 큰 자물쇠가 감긴 정유소 철문 손잡이가 화면 절반 넘게 크게, 그 철망 사이로 멀리 불 꺼진 굴뚝. 옆에서 미국 중년 작업자가 철문을 붙잡고 굳은 표정으로 안을 본다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic object close-up, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with heavy micro-contrast, visible film grain and crisp detailed textures. A thick rusty steel chain and a large heavy padlock wrapped around the handle of a refinery gate fill more than half of the frame in sharp focus, flakes of rust and scratches clearly visible. Through the chain-link fence, softly blurred, idle refinery towers and a cold smokestack under a pale sky. Beside the gate a likeable middle-aged American refinery worker in a worn work jacket grips the fence and looks inside with a stunned, quiet expression. Full color, bright high-key daylight exposure, vivid saturated colors, orange rust versus steel blue. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 — 실물 클로즈업(항공유 급유). 공항 활주로 옆에서 여객기 날개 아래 급유 노즐이 연결되는 순간을 크게, 급유 담당 작업자가 노즐을 잡고 있다. 비행기 기름이 어디서 왔는지 묻는 느낌.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic object close-up at a bright airport apron, gritty high-clarity HDR photo with micro-contrast and fine grain. A heavy aviation fuel nozzle being locked into the refueling port under the wing of a large passenger jet fills the foreground in sharp focus, thick black hose and polished metal coupling, a few droplets glinting. A likeable airport refueling technician in a hi-vis vest and ear defenders holds the nozzle with a focused face. Behind, softly blurred, a fuel truck and the runway under a clear blue sky. Bright high-key daylight, vivid saturated colors, crisp detailed textures. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, airline liveries or brand marks anywhere, no real identifiable people. Avoid: night scene, dark, low-key, moody, crushed blacks, heavy vignette.
